text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: The new year is here☆ We're in the Senior Class starting today, Trainer♪ Which means!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: You want to enjoy a Feng Shui-style New Year that's different from the usual, right? Right!?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's depart☆
Copano Rickey is always high-energy, but this New Year's, she was even more hyped up than usual.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
First, a lucky charm! Buying charms
before praying is the Rickey way☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Don't you feel like visiting in that way
imbues the charm with even more power?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Next, how to pray! Sandwich your wish
between "thank you"s!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, please, and thank you.
Don't forget to thank God in that exact order☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Gratitude isn't just important when praying to the gods, right? Trainer, thank you as always♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"And finally, the fortune slip!
Take your omikuji home without tying it up☆
If you let go of it, you'll forget what it said, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If you put it somewhere you glance at from time to time,
it's guaranteed to help you review your daily routine♪

Copano Rickey's rituals made complete sense once explained,
and they genuinely seemed like they would work.
And so, while we had fun with our shrine visit—
choice_data_list: Hey, Rickey, you seem awfully energetic today.
Hey Ricky, you're really energetic today, huh?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Really?
Seems the same as always to me, though.
choice_data_list: Are you still worried about Hokko Tarumae?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae?! That's not true at all!
Not even a little bit, no way, absolutely not...

...For her to deny it this vehemently,
she might actually be bothered by it after all.

"Stop getting sidetracked by feng shui
and take running seriously."
Those words Hokko Tarumae told me.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer.
According to the annual flow methods, the flow of qi will change completely this year, so—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we go catch that new wave?
To a place where we can see the latest trends.
choice_data_list: Sure, but what place is that?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, even when you say "trends,"
there are all kinds, from recreation to the economy...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whatever genre you prefer, Trainer.
What kind of trends are you looking to know more about?
The first thing that came to mind was—
choice_data_list: The attention of the big shots

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Fun fashion! If we're talking
fashion trends, that's gotta be the place!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A shopping mall is definitely the way to go☆
With all the different brand shops, you can spot the trendy colors in an instant!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's super colorful! Just looking at it
makes me feel more and more energetic!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, those clothes look pretty nice♪
They have all of my lucky colors for this year!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Still~, the price is a bit unhappy. What should I do~...
I lent her a little support. After browsing around various places, Copano Rickey seemed to have cheered right up.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Catching the eye of big shots... When you think of a place
where VIPs gather, it's gotta be there!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A first-rate hotel! Looking at the lobby like this,
you can really get a feel for how rich folks live and what's trendy.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I see, so that shape of vase brings good luck, huh. And the color of the flowers is...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep, I think I brushed up my feng shui
for this year! I feel like I've leveled up☆

Coming into contact with such dignified items
seemed to slightly heighten Copano Rickey's sense of omnipotence.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The movement of the entire town... In that case,
maybe that place with the great view?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the wind looks super strong outside!
It literally feels like a rush of Qi!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the westerly wind from the mainland is strong today.
Ah, looking closely—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Building roofs come in all kinds of shapes, don't they?
Pointy ones, flat ones...
I wonder if that affects your luck too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll look into it a bit.
Things like architecture seem like great study material for improving your luck!

An unexpected discovery made possible
only by looking down from above. Copano Rickey
seemed to have gained a brand-new perspective.
